title: FroggyCraft Lite
description: A simplified version of the vanilla+ modpack FroggyCraft that implements only content related to frogs 🐸 with performance improvements & optimizations for low power PC's
body:
This modpack is a lightweight spin-off of my **[FroggyCraft](https://modrinth.com/modpack/froggycraft)** modpack. It implements FroggyCraft's frog-related content, performance enhancements, and minor technical fixes for the base game. Choose this version if: - You play Minecraft on an older or lower power PC - You want to use this modpack as a starting point for building your own modded experience - You're looking forward to eventually updating to later versions of Minecraft (many mods in the full version of FroggyCraft like Create don't support game versions beyond 1.20.1, at least not yet) Join the [**FroggyCraft Discord**](https://discord.gg/WBQRfBgQEY) to report bugs, get help, and chat with other FroggyCrafters!
![Frog-Related Mods](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7951b553aea5a3eca3dce5c27253048478109c1a_0.webp) - [**_Bucket of Frog_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/bucket-of-frog) (mod): lets you carry frogs in buckets just like axolotls and other aquatics. Warning: this mod is only compatible with the three vanilla variants of frogs, modded frogs from More Frogs 2 will revert to a vanilla variant if placed in a bucket. - [**_Frog Legs_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/froglegs) (mod): adds new block variants for froglights and froglight end rods. Also adds a bunch of new food drops, but that's not important, don't look into it. Remember, frogs are friends not food! - [**_Holdable Frogs_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/holdable-frogs) (mod): lets you pick up frogs and use than as tools – their tongues can grab stuff from far away and drag them towards you. - [**_More Axolotl Variants_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/mavm) (mod): this is a bonus non-frog-related mod, but you wouldn't want your frogs to get lonely, would you? Frogs need their fellow amphibian friends – the more axolotl variants, the more friends – everyone wins! - [**_More Frogs 2_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/morefrogs) (mod): this mod adds new frog variants that will spawn and can be breed only in certain places (the nether, the end, the deep dark, above y=250), they have their own drops, with one unique drop, the Light at the End block. - [**_Ribbits_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/ribbits) (mod): adds villager-like mobs called Ribbits to the came, frog people with their own villages, trades, special items, and fun behaviors. - [**_SpaceFrog's Forever Young Tadpoles_**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/spacefrogs-forever-young-tadpoles) (datapack): showing a tadpole a slime ball causes a quantum-superposition/magic allows the tadpole to clone itself into an ageless tadpole – keep your tadpole friends in their cute tadpole form forever! - [**_SpaceFrog's Hungry Hungry Frogs_**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/spacefrogs-hungry-hungry-frogs) (datapack): frogs will eat hostile mobs. Adds a rare frog variant, The ÜberFrog, an immortal, insatiable frog that can one-shot kill any hostile mob, never taking any damage - makes for a great guard-frog for your base. - [**_SpaceFrog's Recolored Frogs_**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/spacefrogs-recolored-frogs) (resource pack): replaces the skin of the warm variant frogs with something a bit less sickly and pale. So if those pale/whitish frogs ever weirded you out, worry not - they're now a beautiful shade of bright, froggy green. - [**_Villager Frog House_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/villager-frog-house) (mod): now swamp villagers finally have a home, they get to live in a giant frog! Well, more of a frog-shaped communal building, still pretty cool. - **And tons more frog-related customizations and easter eggs implemented through special datapacks and [_KubeJS_](https://modrinth.com/mod/kubejs) scripts.**
Guide for Installation on Servers The following is a step-by-step guide on how to install FroggyCraft Lite on a server hosted by Modrinth, but the general points should be applicable to other hosting services:

  1. Join the FroggyCraft Discord and download the PATCHED_MODS_FOR_SERVERS.zip file from the pinned comment in the "troubleshooting" chat. Unzip the files to your PC.
  2. Log into your account on the Modrinth website. Start a new server or reset an old server and select the installation type "Modpack base".
  3. In the modpack search bar, enter "FroggyCraft Lite", select the modpack, and set the properties you want for the server (e.g., game mode, difficulty, etc.).
  4. Under the "Options" tab you'll see a button labeled "Platform" – click this button and select the option to "Unlink Modpack".
  5. Under the "Content" tab you'll find the mods and datapacks associated with FroggyCraft Lite. Disable all of the mods with the yellow warning triangle indicating they're client-side only mods. In case you're not installing the modpack on a Modrinth hosted server, a complete list of mods to disable is found in the PATCHED_MODS_FOR_SERVERS.zip file.
    Note: You'll see that some mods have updates ready, but do not update any mods or it will likely break compatibility between the various mods of FroggyCraft Lite.
  6. There is one mod that need to be DELETED and replaced with patched versions – Bucket of Frog. Make sure you delete this mods, don't just disable it, the original .jar file need to be absent from the server before the patched file is uploaded.
  7. Click the "Upload files" button and upload the patched .jar file for Bucket of Frog found in the folder on your PC where you unzipped the PATCHED_MODS_FOR_SERVERS.zip file. The patched file name ends in "FROGGYCRAFT_SERVER.jar" so as to avoid confusion with its unpatched version. Ignore the .jar files for Re:Deco, and Structurify - these mods are part of the full FroggyCraft modpack, not FroggyCraft Lite.
    Note: Do not replace the .jar file for Bucket of Frog with its patched version on your local client – FroggyCraft Lite will run perfectly fine on your PC without any modifications and will be able to log into any server running the same version of FroggyCraft Lite so long as the server's mods have been patched.
  8. You're all done setting up the server. Start the server and try logging into it from your PC. You might get an error when first logging in, but just try again, and it should work (this seems to be a sporadic issue related to Modrinth servers). For trouble shooting, join the Discord and ask for help in the troubleshooting chat.
Known Bugs
  • If you rename an ÜberFrog and place it in a bucket, it will lose its special ÜberFrog traits and become a normal frog. This only affects the ÜberFrog when placed in a bucket; otherwise, renaming an ÜberFrog will not remove its special traits.
  • The mods Bucket of Frog has a bug that crash servers. To run FroggyCraft on a server, join the FrogyCraft Discord (link above) and ask for help in the troubleshooting chat.
Future Plans Plans for FroggyCraft Lite v1.2 or later:

  • Pick Your Poison (mod): adds tiny poison dart frogs to the world, and you can lick them and get cool effects! For legal purposes: do not lick poison dart frogs in game or IRL.
  • SpaceFrog's FrogCoin Currency (datapack): pay for villager trades with FrogCoin instead of lousy old emeralds. Your server economy can also run on FrogCoin - FrogCoin for everyone!
  • If you have suggestions or features or changes to the next version of FroggyCraft, let me know by joining the FroggyCraft Discord (see the link at the top of the page).
